issue.title: Runtime, syntax, and CLI cutover to agent session (runtime-cutover)
issue.description: Outside src/sase/ace, sase names the former agent-family concept "agent session" in every module, identifier, comment, message, and test. %id(..., session=), agent queries session:/kind:session, --next-fork session, gate spec "fork": "session", and SASE_AGENT_SESSION_ATTACH are the canonical user syntax.
